text.tk:
Present Perfect Continuous geçmişde başlanyp, häzire çenli dowam edýän ýa-da ýaňy gutaran we netijesi görünýän hereketi aňladýar.
Düzülişi: have/has + been + işlik-ing
• I have been studying for two hours.
• She has been waiting since 9 o'clock.
Inkär: I haven't been sleeping well.
Sorag: How long have you been learning English?
Wagt sözleri:
• for — dowamlylyk: for two hours, for a week
• since — başlanan pursat: since Monday, since 2020
Üns beriň: duýgy we eýeçilik işlikleri (know, like, want, have = eýe bolmak) bu wagtda ulanylmaýar: I have known him for years.
text.ru:
Present Perfect Continuous обозначает действие, которое началось в прошлом и продолжается до сих пор, или только что закончилось и его результат заметен.
Образование: have/has + been + глагол-ing
• I have been studying for two hours.
• She has been waiting since 9 o'clock.
Отрицание: I haven't been sleeping well.
Вопрос: How long have you been learning English?
Слова-маркеры:
• for — длительность: for two hours, for a week
• since — момент начала: since Monday, since 2020
Внимание: глаголы состояния (know, like, want, have = иметь) в этом времени не используются: I have known him for years.

text.tk:
Ýagdaý: Aman sagat 3-de futbol oýnap başlady. Häzir sagat 5, ol henizem oýnaýar.
1) Hereket geçmişde başlandy we dowam edýär → Present Perfect Continuous.
2) Ega «he» → has.
3) has + been + playing.
4) Dowamlylyk 2 sagat → for.
Jogap: He has been playing football for two hours.
Ýa-da: He has been playing football since 3 o'clock.
text.ru:
Ситуация: Аман начал играть в футбол в 3 часа. Сейчас 5 часов, он всё ещё играет.
1) Действие началось в прошлом и продолжается → Present Perfect Continuous.
2) Подлежащее «he» → has.
3) has + been + playing.
4) Длительность 2 часа → for.
Ответ: He has been playing football for two hours.
Или: He has been playing football since 3 o'clock.

text.tk:
Second conditional häzirki ýa-da geljekdäki hyýaly, gowşak ähtimal ýagdaýlar barada gürrüň edýär.
Düzülişi:
If + Past Simple, would + işlik (esasy görnüş)
• If I had a million dollars, I would travel around the world.
• If she lived near the sea, she would swim every day.
Tertibi üýtgäp biler (onda otur goýulmaýar): I would help you if I knew the answer.
Ýatlaň: «be» işligi ähli ýöňkemelerde köplenç «were»: If I were you, I would study more.
Deňeşdiriň: First conditional — hakyky mümkinçilik: If it rains, I will stay home.
text.ru:
Второй тип условных (second conditional) описывает воображаемые, маловероятные ситуации в настоящем или будущем.
Образование:
If + Past Simple, would + глагол (начальная форма)
• If I had a million dollars, I would travel around the world.
• If she lived near the sea, she would swim every day.
Порядок частей можно менять (тогда без запятой): I would help you if I knew the answer.
Запомните: «be» обычно стоит в форме «were» для всех лиц: If I were you, I would study more.
Сравните: First conditional — реальная возможность: If it rains, I will stay home.

text.tk:
Pikir: «Meniň itim ýok, ýöne bolsady, her gün onuň bilen gezerdim.»
1) Hakykat: itim ýok → hyýaly ýagdaý → second conditional.
2) Şert bölegi: If + Past Simple → If I had a dog.
3) Netije: would + işlik → I would walk it every day.
Jogap: If I had a dog, I would walk it every day.
text.ru:
Мысль: «У меня нет собаки, но если бы была, я бы гулял с ней каждый день.»
1) Реальность: собаки нет → воображаемая ситуация → second conditional.
2) Условие: If + Past Simple → If I had a dog.
3) Результат: would + глагол → I would walk it every day.
Ответ: If I had a dog, I would walk it every day.

text.tk: Ýazyjy Gerbert Uells (H. G. Wells) 1895-nji ýylda «Wagt maşyny» romanyny çap etdi. «Eger biz wagtda syýahat edip bilsedik näme bolardy?» diýen hyýaly sorag şondan bäri ylmy fantastikanyň iň meşhur temalarynyň birine öwrüldi.
text.ru: Писатель Герберт Уэллс (H. G. Wells) опубликовал роман «Машина времени» в 1895 году. Вопрос «что было бы, если бы мы могли путешествовать во времени?» с тех пор стал одной из самых популярных тем научной фантастики.

text.tk:
Passive voice (gaýdym nyşan) hereketiň özüne ýa-da onuň obýektine üns berilende ulanylýar; hereketi eden adam möhüm däl ýa-da näbelli.
Past Simple Passive: was/were + üçünji görnüş (Past Participle)
• The bridge was built in 1990.
• These pictures were painted by a famous artist.
Hereketi edeni «by» bilen görkezmek bolýar: The telephone was invented by Bell.
Inkär: The letter wasn't sent.
Sorag: When was the school opened?
Was — birlik (it, he, she), were — köplük (they, the books).
text.ru:
Пассивный залог (passive voice) используется, когда важно само действие или его объект, а исполнитель неважен или неизвестен.
Past Simple Passive: was/were + 3-я форма глагола (Past Participle)
• The bridge was built in 1990.
• These pictures were painted by a famous artist.
Исполнителя можно указать с помощью «by»: The telephone was invented by Bell.
Отрицание: The letter wasn't sent.
Вопрос: When was the school opened?
Was — единственное число, were — множественное.

text.tk:
Işjeň sözlem: «Workers built the stadium in 2010.»
1) Obýekti tapýarys: the stadium → ol täze ega bolar.
2) Birlik → was.
3) build → built (üçünji görnüş).
4) Işçiler möhüm däl → «by workers» taşlanýar.
Jogap: The stadium was built in 2010.
text.ru:
Активное предложение: «Workers built the stadium in 2010.»
1) Находим объект: the stadium → он станет новым подлежащим.
2) Единственное число → was.
3) build → built (3-я форма).
4) Рабочие неважны → «by workers» опускаем.
Ответ: The stadium was built in 2010.

text.tk: Eýfel diňi Pariždäki 1889-njy ýylyň Bütindünýä sergisi üçin guruldy. Ilki ony wagtlaýyn desga hasaplapdylar, ýöne radio antennasy hökmünde peýdaly bolany üçin saklanyp galdy.

text.tk:
Reported speech — biriniň aýdanyny öz sözlerimiz bilen gürrüň bermek.
Eger giriş işlik geçen wagtda bolsa (said, told), wagtlar bir ädim yza süýşýär:
• Present Simple → Past Simple: «I like tea.» → She said (that) she liked tea.
• Present Continuous → Past Continuous
• Past Simple / Present Perfect → Past Perfect
• will → would, can → could
Çalyşmalar we wagt sözleri hem üýtgeýär:
• now → then, today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, yesterday → the day before, here → there
say vs tell: He said (that)… / He told me (that)… — tell-den soň kime aýdylandygy görkezilýär.
text.ru:
Косвенная речь — пересказ чужих слов.
Если вводный глагол в прошедшем времени (said, told), времена сдвигаются на шаг назад:
• Present Simple → Past Simple: «I like tea.» → She said (that) she liked tea.
• Present Continuous → Past Continuous
• Past Simple / Present Perfect → Past Perfect
• will → would, can → could
Меняются также местоимения и слова времени/места:
• now → then, today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, yesterday → the day before, here → there
say vs tell: He said (that)… / He told me (that)… — после tell указывается, кому сказали.

text.tk:
Göni söz: Merjen said, «I am reading a book now.»
1) Wagt: am reading (Present Continuous) → was reading.
2) Çalyşma: I → she.
3) now → then.
Jogap: Merjen said (that) she was reading a book then.
text.ru:
Прямая речь: Merjen said, «I am reading a book now.»
1) Время: am reading (Present Continuous) → was reading.
2) Местоимение: I → she.
3) now → then.
Ответ: Merjen said (that) she was reading a book then.

text.tk: Habarçylar gytaklaýyn sözi her gün ulanýarlar. Habar agentlikleri, mysal üçin Reuters we Associated Press, öz žurnalistleri üçin sitatalary we gürrüň berlen sözleri nädip dogry bermelidigini düşündirýän ýörite stil gollanmalaryny çap edýärler.
text.ru: Журналисты пользуются косвенной речью каждый день. Новостные агентства, например Reuters и Associated Press, выпускают для своих сотрудников специальные стилевые руководства, где объясняется, как правильно передавать цитаты и чужие слова.

text.tk:
Käbir işliklerden soň gerund (işlik + -ing), käbirlerinden soň infinitive (to + işlik) gelýär.
Gerund-dan öň: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, suggest, keep, practise
• I enjoy reading. She finished cleaning.
Infinitive-den öň: want, decide, hope, plan, agree, promise, learn, need
• I want to learn Spanish. They decided to stay.
Predloglardan soň elmydama gerund: I'm good at drawing. Thank you for helping.
Manysy üýtgeýän işlikler:
• stop smoking = çekmegi bes etmek; stop to smoke = çekmek üçin saklanmak
• remember doing = edenini ýatlamak; remember to do = etmegi ýatdan çykarmazlyk
text.ru:
После одних глаголов используется герундий (глагол + -ing), после других — инфинитив (to + глагол).
Перед герундием: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, suggest, keep, practise
• I enjoy reading. She finished cleaning.
Перед инфинитивом: want, decide, hope, plan, agree, promise, learn, need
• I want to learn Spanish. They decided to stay.
После предлогов — всегда герундий: I'm good at drawing. Thank you for helping.
Глаголы, меняющие смысл:
• stop smoking = бросить курить; stop to smoke = остановиться, чтобы покурить
• remember doing = помнить, что сделал; remember to do = не забыть сделать

text.tk:
Sözlem: «We decided ___ (go) to the park, and we enjoyed ___ (play) there.»
1) decide → infinitive: to go.
2) enjoy → gerund: playing.
Jogap: We decided to go to the park, and we enjoyed playing there.
text.ru:
Предложение: «We decided ___ (go) to the park, and we enjoyed ___ (play) there.»
1) decide → инфинитив: to go.
2) enjoy → герундий: playing.
Ответ: We decided to go to the park, and we enjoyed playing there.

text.tk: Lingwistler iňlis dilinde iň köp ulanylýan sözleri öwrenmek üçin uly tekst ýygyndylaryny (korpuslary) ulanýarlar. Bu ýygyndylar «enjoy» işliginden soň -ing görnüşiň, «want» işliginden soň bolsa «to» görnüşiň hemişe diýen ýaly gelýändigini tassyklaýar.
text.ru: Лингвисты изучают употребление слов с помощью больших текстовых собраний — корпусов. Корпусные данные подтверждают, что после «enjoy» почти всегда идёт форма -ing, а после «want» — форма с «to».

text.tk:
Opinion essay — bir mesele boýunça öz pikiriňi delilleriň kömegi bilen düşündirýän gysga ýazgy.
Gurluşy (4–5 abzas):
• Introduction: temany görkez we öz pikiriňi aýt.
• Body 1, Body 2: her abzasda bir delil + mysal.
• (Islege görä) garşy pikir we oňa jogap.
• Conclusion: pikiriňi başga sözler bilen gaýtala.
Peýdaly aňlatmalar:
• Pikir: In my opinion, I believe, I strongly feel that
• Sanamak: Firstly, Secondly, Furthermore, In addition
• Garşy pikir: On the other hand, However, Some people argue that
• Netije: To sum up, In conclusion
Stil: resmi; gysgaltmalar (don't, can't) ulanylmaýar.
text.ru:
Эссе-мнение — небольшое сочинение, в котором автор излагает свою точку зрения по вопросу и подкрепляет её аргументами.
Структура (4–5 абзацев):
• Introduction: обозначить тему и высказать своё мнение.
• Body 1, Body 2: в каждом абзаце один аргумент + пример.
• (По желанию) противоположное мнение и ответ на него.
• Conclusion: повторить мнение другими словами.
Полезные выражения:
• Мнение: In my opinion, I believe, I strongly feel that
• Перечисление: Firstly, Secondly, Furthermore, In addition
• Контраргумент: On the other hand, However, Some people argue that
• Вывод: To sum up, In conclusion
Стиль: нейтрально-формальный; сокращения (don't, can't) не используются.

text.tk:
Tema: «Should students wear school uniforms?»
• Introduction: Many schools require uniforms. In my opinion, uniforms are a good idea.
• Body 1: Firstly, uniforms make all students equal, so nobody feels poorer than others.
• Body 2: Secondly, they save time in the morning because students do not need to choose clothes.
• Counter-argument: On the other hand, some people argue that uniforms limit self-expression. However, students can express themselves through hobbies and ideas.
• Conclusion: To sum up, I believe the advantages of uniforms are greater than the disadvantages.
text.ru:
Тема: «Should students wear school uniforms?»
• Introduction: Many schools require uniforms. In my opinion, uniforms are a good idea.
• Body 1: Firstly, uniforms make all students equal, so nobody feels poorer than others.
• Body 2: Secondly, they save time in the morning because students do not need to choose clothes.
• Counter-argument: On the other hand, some people argue that uniforms limit self-expression. However, students can express themselves through hobbies and ideas.
• Conclusion: To sum up, I believe the advantages of uniforms are greater than the disadvantages.

text.tk: «Esse» sözi fransuz «essai» — «synanyşyk» sözünden gelýär. Bu žanry XVI asyrda fransuz ýazyjysy Mişel de Monten döretdi: ol öz pikirlerini «Esseler» atly kitabynda beýan etdi.
text.ru: Слово «эссе» происходит от французского «essai» — «попытка, опыт». Жанр создал в XVI веке французский писатель Мишель де Монтень, изложивший свои размышления в книге «Опыты» («Essais»).
